current_example.title: Example: The Product Rule With Cube Roots

q-68551.name: Question 1
q-68551.worked_solution:
The square root of a product of two positive numbers is equal to the product of the square roots of the numbers. Therefore,

$$
\sqrt{50}=\sqrt{25\cdot 2}=\sqrt{25}\cdot \sqrt{2}=5\sqrt{2}.
$$

$$

q-68819.name: Question 6
q-68819.worked_solution:
The cube root of a product of two numbers is equal to the product of the cube roots of the numbers. Therefore,

$$
\sqrt[3]{32}=\sqrt[3]{8\cdot 4}=\sqrt[3]{8}\cdot \sqrt[3]{4}=2\sqrt[3]{4}.
$$
